note: Hand-authored fixture — Snipe's suggestion job and per-idea chat threads are not built. Actions render disabled-with-reason and the composer is inert.

ideas.title: Cache the symbol index between sessions
ideas.why: Cartographer re-indexes src/ every cold start. A content-hashed cache would save ~2m and $0.03 per run.

chat.author: Snipe
chat.text: Where should the cache live — per-repo in .pd/, or in the daemon's SQLite so it survives worktree churn?

chat.author: You
chat.text: Daemon SQLite. Worktrees come and go; the index shouldn't.

chat.author: Snipe
chat.text: Agreed. I'll draft an ADR and a spike PR for Cartographer to review. Keyed on content hash so a stale tree invalidates cleanly.
